trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is no extra task, no online play and no DLC involved. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and Push Square at up to 300 hours or more, with most of that time going to the 100% checklist behind A Long Road.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story, so it comes to you — play through the opening and the trophy pops at the end of it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies are automatic: finish every story mission in the chapter and this pops when the chapter closes.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic, and it is also the chapter where you first get to play as both characters, which the last meditation spot needs.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. There is no way to miss a chapter trophy — finish the chapter's story missions in order and it pops when the chapter closes.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The story runs five chapters in all, so this is the last chapter trophy before the finale.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. After the credits the game returns you to free-roam, so this is the doorway to the cleanup phase, not the end of the run — the 100% checklist only becomes viewable after the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the mission order. Named-mission trophies are automatic once the mission is finished.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the big set-piece missions of the campaign, and the trophy pops as soon as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Keep playing the story in order and it will arrive on its own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Another automatic story-mission trophy — no side task is needed for it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport mission. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like the other named-mission trophies, it pops the moment the mission is done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The longest trophy in the game. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it still demands every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and every Bret quest, plus 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets, and 70 of the 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest ten.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across your driving — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all feed the count, and it builds up naturally over a 200-hour run. Check your progress on the Progress screen; if you are short at the end, chain jumps and near misses on a long highway stretch.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — a single taste of each is enough, you do not have to master any of them. Work through the activities the game lists (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, bowling, meditation, drone racing and the rest) and tick them off as you sample them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the ranges of Leonida. PowerPyx notes the gold thresholds are not too difficult — take your time on each range, learn its targets, and replay the ones you miss until they turn gold. Every range is also needed for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course to learn — fly the racing line, cut the corners the course allows, and come back to the ones you lose until you have won at every spot. Drone races are also one of the full-completion items on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need breadth, not repeats of one easy course. Any race type counts; work through the race spots across Leonida and keep the wins varied.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots, take his challenge, and out-fish him — the fishing itself is one of the game's activities, so a little practice with the casting and reeling first makes the head-to-head much easier.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Pick a cabinet, play its game through to the end, and the trophy pops — any game on any machine counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. Andy's missions are Lucia-only, according to GTABase, so play them as Lucia whenever they appear — and remember that even after the story, every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back, so a strand you left half-done can still be finished.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Take Kenton's missions as they appear on the map and follow the strand to its last job.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Work through Billy's missions in order until the strand closes with its last job.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions show up as you explore, and the named strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret among them — each count toward the eight. Stranger missions are not part of the 100% checklist, so this is a cleanup-phase job; after the story, every quest giver tied to a trophy returns, so finish the strands you started.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Follow Randy's missions as they appear and see the strand through to its last job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only, according to GTABase, so play them as Jason — and if the strand is still open after the story, it comes back, so you can finish it in free-roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy the guides flag. Meditate at every spot across Leonida, 18 spots in all. The first one is the risk: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and take her invitation, before you leave Chapter 1. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both warn that this first meditation may not be repeatable later, and it is not yet settled whether it counts toward the total, so do it when it is offered. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, as part of Bret's quest strand — Bret's quests are also one of the full-completion items on the 100% checklist, and Bret's strand is Jason-only. Which animal counts as the unique one is still being pinned down by the guide sites, so follow Bret's strand and take the hunt he offers; do not trust a named animal from a single source until the guides agree.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and 15 of them are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy comes early in the card hunt — pick up cards wherever you find them across Leonida and complete any three sets first.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — point it at the world and log what you find. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also feeds the 100% checklist, which needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so make scanning a habit from the start of the game and the 100 locations will pile up on their own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game holds 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and only 70 are needed for 100% completion — so for this trophy, and for the checklist, you can skip the hardest ten entirely and pick the fifty that suit you.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, get out of the search area, and hide until the stars clear — the trophy pops when the heat is gone and you are free.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive between them — do not let the heat drop before the third robbery. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, hit each one quickly, and keep moving so the cops stay on you until the third is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter new models and they count. There are 277 base-model vehicles in the game, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of them scanned, so drive everything you see and scan with WAiNK as you go; the first hundred discoveries come fast.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group, trigger Combat Focus when several enemies are in view, and drop five before it runs out — a crowded shootout is the easiest place to line it up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The official description is one line — an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. The best reading is to leave the airport by an unauthorised route or in a vehicle that is not a scheduled flight, rather than boarding a plane normally. The guide sites have not yet settled on one exact method, so treat any single how-to with care until they agree.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The description only hints at Rhino tanks. The best reading is that it involves taking on, surviving or dealing with Rhino tanks at a high wanted level — but the exact trigger has not yet been settled by the guide sites, so this one is a lead, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the guards, take what you came for, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults come with the bank jobs — the 100% checklist wants eight vault robberies in total — so work through the bank jobs, crack the vault, grab the take and lose the heat before the next.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run the roads of Leonida — stop one, take its cargo, and lose the wanted level that follows before you call it done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every named area on the map until each one registers — the map itself is your checklist, so sweep the corners you never had a mission in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, not all of them. There are 39 gang operations in total for the 100% checklist, so keep hitting operations and watch the gang count: once every gang has lost one operation to you, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The best reading is a bar spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, where you order and drink a cocktail — but the exact spot and trigger have not yet been settled by the guide sites, so treat this as a lead until they agree.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The description says to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The best reading is to drive a vehicle straight out through the showroom's glass front — a nod to the series' classic showroom smash — but the exact showroom and trigger have not yet been settled by the guide sites.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game there. Bowling is one of the game's activities, and this trophy is simply about doing it at that named alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The official description is a riddle — a partnership with mass appeal. The best reading is a partner activity done in front of a crowd, or a partnership moment the public notices, but the guide sites have not yet settled on the exact trigger, so this is a lead, not a confirmed method.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The description says only that choices are made, for better or worse, and PlayStation tracks a progress count for this trophy. The best reading is that it accumulates as you make story and side choices across the game — keep playing, keep choosing, and it should land on its own — but the exact trigger has not yet been settled by the guide sites.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The description says second time's the charm. The best reading is that you fail at something, then succeed at the same thing on your second try — but which attempt counts, and at what, has not yet been settled by the guide sites, so this is a lead until they agree.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: METHOD STILL BEING CONFIRMED. The description reads like a reaction to something strange. The best reading is that you witness an unexplained event or oddity somewhere in Leonida — the kind of thing players stumble into while exploring — but the exact event has not yet been settled by the guide sites, so this is a lead until they agree.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, rather than a gun. Drive past a pedestrian target, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops when they go down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — hand them to your laundering contacts over the course of the run and the total builds up. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and check the running total on the Progress screen.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, in total — clothes, weapons, vehicles and anything else the shops sell all count toward the same running total. It builds up over a normal run; if you are short at the end, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages come up for sale as you progress and earn money — buy each one when it appears rather than saving it all for the end, and the trophy pops with the last deed.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find or buy vehicles you like, then register each one in the app — ten registrations, any ten vehicles, and the trophy is yours.
